name: Garfield's Wild Ride Vita
author: MemoryHunter
description: Garfield's Wild Ride is a 2013 action-casual endless runner game developed by Vetasoft. Taking place entirely in the lazy cat's daydreams, players use simple one-touch controls to fly Garfield through the air, dodge obstacles, and collect lasagna and coins to unlock power-ups and crazy costumes.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
